summary: Build HACCP, FSSC 22000, and audit-ready food safety skills. Train with practical templates, casework, and certification-focused exercises.
lede: FSSC 22000 training helps food safety professionals build and assess controls within a food safety management system. Participants practice HACCP hazard analysis, CCP decision-making and monitoring, while learning to verify prerequisite programmes and manage nonconformances. The course also covers collecting audit evidence and preparing management review inputs for practical oversight of food safety controls.
audienceIntro: This Food Safety Management (HACCP / FSSC 22000) Training is built for professionals who already work with food safety controls and now need stronger system-level capability, audit readiness, and certification confidence.
prerequisites: Advanced level requires prior working knowledge of HACCP principles, prerequisite programmes, and ISO 22000:2018 or an equivalent food safety management system. You should be comfortable reading process flow diagrams, reviewing monitoring records, and participating in internal audits; no coding is required. The course works best if you bring recent examples of your site hazard analysis, CCP records, corrective actions, or supplier audit findings for practical exercises.
